parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: CenOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the CEN instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the network instance to uninstall.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the network instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud.

- **VBR**: virtual border router.

- **CCN**: Cloud Connect Network.
